resource_geometry.basis: Pinned config plus safetensors header shapes; packed/decode and activation overhead remain unproven.

archive.algorithm: sha256(ustar: sorted regular files; mode=0644; uid=gid=mtime=0)

panel.name: malaiwah Qwen3.8-27B suite v5, shard 0 -- 512 contexts

determinism.note: a single cold capture; cross-run determinism is NOT asserted here. Capture a second cold run and run `fidelity-dataset compare --self-compare` -- an exactly 0.0 result is the SC-1 reproduction confirmation.

disclosures.detail: 15 checkpoint tensor(s) were present but intentionally unused by this architecture. Their complete set exactly matched pinned allowlist e3d1807f1fc6a7d9c560ca76d30c865b51a835139f6525313431f36162a3fc1e (canonical sorted-name SHA-256 8cadbfe029ec03d26d19a94845830662c4220caa1b9293ab908b76099355217e).

this dataset is ONE cold capture (run_count 1, the DET-D4 floor is 5). Cross-run determinism is not asserted by the dataset; it is established by a second cold capture plus `fidelity-dataset compare --self-compare`, whose exactly-0.0 result is the SC-1 reproduction confirmation.

generation_sanity_probe.note: one extra window through the same schedule; its hidden state is discarded and never enters the dataset.

divergences.reason: every capture declares its OWN head identity by tensor content digest; the comparator refuses a hidden-form comparison across differing heads.
lane is required and gated at compare time so registry BIAS-006 is checked before a number exists, not at submission.
scoring_window is part of panel identity, not a comparator flag: a score_from=1024 number is a different panel, not a variant.
self-compare is a first-class mode asserting exactly 0.0.
required, fp64 default; an fp32 estimator lands in a different comparability class on the same data and that must be visible.
declared vs present record counts with shard_of; fixes our own manifest that claimed 5,120 captures in a 512-file repository.
the panel is a separately referenceable object, which is what makes a candidate capture publishable standalone.
lets a llama.cpp .kld be ingested without laundering a lossy capture as exact.
our packed and streaming lanes vary mask construction; a single-request capture path makes it invariant and has no equivalent field.
hidden form is the default; logit form must declare head_separable:false with a reason.

scoring_window.policy: every causal prediction position of every window is scored; nothing is dropped

covers: every published file except checksums.txt and fidelity-dataset.json, via checksums.txt
fidelity-dataset.json itself, via the self-blanked seal
every capture tensor a second time by CONTENT, via capture.capture_content_digest

notes: This estimate is not an account-level hard spending cap. HF enforces the requested timeout; startup, rounding and storage have separate semantics.
Jobs are billed to malaiwah, not the Space owner. CPU Basic Jobs are not free CPU Basic Space hosting.
Results persist in your private bucket. No bearer token is passed to model code.
Capture/reconstruction proves its declared scope, not native serving kernels or model quality.
Replay and fp64 estimator: cuda / cuda, fp32 own-head replay, full vocabulary; no backend fallback.
At most 1 active QFS Jobs authorized for this launch; unresolved creations always block.

Full 512 original 2048-token contexts, score_from=0; no subset. Declared 4 bits retains the artifact author's global nominal metadata for loader compatibility; it is not observed, effective or average precision. Exact byte-derived per-class assignments govern this mixed scope: MLP gate/up K5, down K6; text attention/head K6, with F16/BF16 retained tensors. Stored MTP is 1 K4 + 2 K5 + 5 K6 modules and 7 BF16 tensors, not executed; its exact 15 omitted logical names are inferred from 39 physical components until the runtime load report confirms them. Vision behavior is not measured. EXL3 reconstruction and F16 passthrough weights are rounded to BF16 for Transformers text forward with the artifact's own reconstructed head; no native-serving parity claim.

Unexercised exact-artifact forward and unqualified runtime proposal, not measured fit or throughput. Supply the repository and immutable revision of an actually published sealed reference dataset; no reference is assumed.

assignments.note: One BF16 text embedding tensor retained in the artifact. Scope derives from malaiwah/Qwen3.8-27B-EXL3-K5K6-hydrated@853acef0b24961b269cdcf32b1ebb405649b545b quantization_manifest.json (sha256 db9b03fb2bb8fa9219e266a825ee028f6ed1420f4de2617d752143dee9ed4c4d), quantization_config.json tensor_storage (sha256 bdf00572254e104c61474e8006054e8666f03c24be523e4ddfb52766fefeffee), and model.safetensors.index.json (sha256 ea6e0e1064efbb72d89b4a6f9e0ee76c909a94b3f25047487a2ffb282896a26c). Metadata evidence, not a completed forward. Declared 4 bits retains the artifact author's global nominal metadata for loader compatibility, not observed, effective or average precision; these exact byte-derived per-class assignments govern the mixed scope.

96 K6 modules: 48 linear_attn.in_proj_qkv and 16 each of self_attn.q_proj, k_proj and v_proj. Stored EXL3 weights reconstructed and rounded to BF16 for the text reference-forward; no native activation/kernel parity is asserted.
64 K6 modules: 48 linear_attn.out_proj and 16 self_attn.o_proj. Reconstructed to BF16 for text forward.

48 x quantized:exl3-mcg@6 (linear_attn.in_proj_z); 96 x native:fp16@16 (linear_attn.in_proj_a.weight and in_proj_b.weight); 192 x native:bf16@16 (linear_attn.A_log, conv1d.weight, dt_bias and norm.weight); 32 x native:bf16@16 (self_attn.k_norm.weight and q_norm.weight). The artifact retains these native F16/BF16 tensors; F16 passthrough weights are converted to BF16 for this forward, an additional disclosed precision conversion.
64 text MLP gate_proj K5 modules, reconstructed to BF16.
64 text MLP up_proj K5 modules, reconstructed to BF16.
64 text MLP down_proj K6 modules, reconstructed to BF16.
129 BF16 text layer/final norm tensors; attention and MTP companions are counted separately in their own classes.
One K6/mcg lm_head reconstructed to BF16 and sealed as this artifact's own head; not shared with the reference. Head replay uses the declared Jobs replay precision/backend.

Stored, not removed: 1 x quantized:exl3-mcg@4 (mtp.fc); 2 x quantized:exl3-mcg@5 (mtp.layers.0.mlp.gate_proj and up_proj); 5 x quantized:exl3-mcg@6 (mtp.layers.0.mlp.down_proj and self_attn.k_proj, o_proj, q_proj, v_proj); 7 x native:bf16@16 (mtp.layers.0.input_layernorm.weight, post_attention_layernorm.weight, self_attn.k_norm.weight, self_attn.q_norm.weight, mtp.norm.weight, mtp.pre_fc_norm_embedding.weight, mtp.pre_fc_norm_hidden.weight). These 39 physical components map to 15 expected omitted logical names in the candidate-bound inventory. This mapping is inferred from pinned metadata and loader routing, not an observed exact-artifact runtime load report. Text capture does not execute MTP; any unexpected-name mismatch must refuse.
333 BF16 vision-tower tensors retained in the artifact, including 27 vision blocks. Text-only capture does not measure vision behavior.

resources.limitations: Accounted planning floors with explicit margins, NOT a peak-memory bound or runtime/fit proof. Architecture-specific states, allocator/workspace/decode peaks and throughput are unqualified. Worker rechecks actual available resources before capture.
